resources.string: Mark’s personal NOVA build · Edition 3\n6.4.63-mark.3 · heretoecode/aos-Video

Edition 3

• Try new UI: optional top navigation and slate playback controls. Classic UI remains the default.
• Documentaries is back in the TV shows row, with a main settings toggle. Brighter text.
• Streaming links paused as requested. Saved country/provider choices are retained.
• TV metadata lookup by TMDb or IMDb ID/link; matches without artwork remain visible.
• Subtitle work runs in the background; cancelled search cleanup and poster retries.
• Safer backups include settings, archive validation and recovery copies.
• Internal components restricted and sensitive logging removed.
• Optimised APK with the same personal signing identity.

Test candidate: the full playback mock-up, chapters, preview generation, scan counters and Up Next panel remain outstanding.
Full notes: docs/MARK-EDITION-3.md in our repository.
